name: Wall torch in an iron sconce
description: A wrought-iron wall bracket, a riveted plate with two scrolls, holding a pitch torch that leans out from the wall: a wooden haft, a dark pitch-soaked rag head bound with cord, glowing at the top under a short flame.

provenance.prompt: An iron wall bracket with a pitch torch, about 0.3 x 0.35 x 0.6 m; anchors fire:torch and light:torch.
